  • Method Details

    • registerSessionUser

      public boolean registerSessionUser(String username, IWebSession session)
      Once a user has created a connection, a session will be associated with their username. This will be used later to send messages to specific usernames that currently have a session open.
      Specified by:
      registerSessionUser in interface IWebSocketManager
      Parameters:
      username - username associated with this session
      session - session that was created
      Returns:
      true if session was created false if that session is not connected or accounted for.

    • sendMsgToUser

      public void sendMsgToUser(String username, String msg)
      Will send a message to a desired username, a single user can have multiple sessions, so this will send message to each session user has open. (Multiple tabs on single computer etc.)
      Specified by:
      sendMsgToUser in interface IWebSocketManager
      Parameters:
      username - username we wish to send message to
      msg - message we will send to user

    • sendMsgToUsers

      public void sendMsgToUsers(List<String> usernames, String msg)
      Will send a message to a list of usernames, used for broadcasting to multiple users for a single message.
      Specified by:
      sendMsgToUsers in interface IWebSocketManager
      Parameters:
      usernames - list of usernames we wish to send message to
      msg - message we will send to all users
